        f'with an average of ${s["mean"]:,.2f} (range: ${s["min"]:,.2f} to ${s["max"]:,.2f}).'
    )

        pct = top_cnt / info["count"] * 100 if info["count"] > 0 else 0
        insights.append(

        )
insights.append(f"The dataset contains {total_orders} orders across {len(headers)} data fields.")

# Cancelled orders insight
for v, c in status_top:

        cancel_pct = c / total_orders * 100
        insights.append(f"{c} out of {total_orders} orders were cancelled ({cancel_pct:.1f}% cancellation rate).")

    doc.add_paragraph(ins, style="List Bullet")
